scheme_name: Financial Assistance for Marriage of Poor Scheduled Caste Brides
other_conditions: Parent/guardian of the bride must be an Indian citizen
Parent/guardian must belong to Scheduled Caste
Parent/guardian must be a native of Puducherry
Assistance is provided only for the first marriage of each daughter
Assistance is available for up to two daughters in a family
Application must be submitted at least 30 days before the marriage date
Applicant must not be receiving financial assistance from other sources
Marriage must be performed in accordance with the law
Bride must be at least 18 years old
Bridegroom must be at least 21 years old
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹15,000 for each of the first two daughters' marriages.
